riskRegister.operator_notes: Generated no-secret risk register. It summarizes launch blockers and accepted local-baseline risks; it does not complete external evidence.

riskRegister.risk_acceptance_policy: Accepted-risk rows require owner approval, an expiry, a reference, and matching public-beta evidence status where they affect launch claims.

risks.mitigation: Retain a reviewed external audit report, map findings to issues, add remediation evidence, and keep post-audit remediation blocked until accepted by maintainers.

risks.source: clean-main reviewer rebaseline and release evidence blockers
risks.title: Completed external audit and post-audit remediation are missing

risks.mitigation: Generate this risk register from the committed roadmap, backlog, blocker reports, Slither baseline, and audit package, then fail local and CI checks on missing categories, stale hashes, or unsafe accepted-risk metadata.
risks.residual_risk: The register can only summarize committed public evidence; it does not replace real external audit, production ceremony, or marketplace evidence.
risks.title: Risk register and audit-boundary drift

risks.mitigation: Retain reviewed fork, testnet, metadata browser, ceremony, randomizer, verified address, and explorer evidence through the no-secret evidence intake.
risks.residual_risk: Local and fork artifacts do not prove public testnet or live-chain deployment behavior, explorer verification, or indexer-visible state.
risks.source: public-beta evidence status and clean-main reviewer rebaseline
risks.title: Public beta external execution evidence remains incomplete

risks.mitigation: Retain reviewed Safe ownership, role grants, signer manager, pause guardian, emergency recipient, signer custody, rotation, and monitoring evidence.
risks.residual_risk: Production authority could be misunderstood or unverifiable without reviewed ceremony artifacts and custody evidence.
risks.source: signer custody readiness and admin ceremony evidence model
risks.title: Production governance ceremony and signer custody proof are missing

risks.mitigation: Implement a fail-closed record-family classifier and exact family-to-authority mapping, reject undeclared families, enforce every-family snapshot authority, persist the authorization class, and retain independently reviewed candidate-bound grant, lifecycle, runtime, and deployment evidence.
risks.residual_risk: A compromised or over-broad metadata/preservation writer can publish records for every record family accepted by the target launch module.
risks.source: CON-015 launch metadata and preservation authorization model
risks.title: Metadata satellite writer grants are whole-module

risks.mitigation: Implement and bind a closed-world target, selector, and native-value action policy; review every balance source and destination; retain hostile target, reentrancy, value-exhaustion, refund, and atomic-rollback tests; prove the policy in deployment evidence; and complete independent review before governance ownership cutover.
risks.residual_risk: The Executor can forward proposal-selected native value from a governed batch. Bounded assembly prevents returndata bombs but is invisible to Slither's arbitrary-send-eth detector and does not constrain destination, value, balance source, or downstream call semantics.
risks.source: Historical Slither arbitrary-send-eth fingerprint sha256:c1b7db0f62e7ff01758e147d41188f1d33ea9a448efb0162d98b14e3ef11cbe8; live semantic anchor StreamGovernanceExecutor._executeCall(bytes32,uint256,GovernanceCall,bytes) assembly call
risks.title: Governance Executor proposal-selected native-value authority

risks.mitigation: Complete the checked versioned 22-GGP/3-GTP inventory by binding every row to the required production profile instance, genesis value, immutable floor, failure class or cadence rule, reviewed candidate-bound measurement evidence, and reachable fixed-stipend raise chains; bind the concrete candidate and keep strict production release mode fail-closed on every unresolved row.
risks.residual_risk: The committed inventory is a structurally checked planning artifact. It does not yet prove that the 37-entry production candidate registers every governed parameter on the correct deployed host with safe values, floors, cadence evidence, or downstream gas compatibility.
risks.source: ADR 0017 governed-parameter closed world and issue #684
risks.title: Governed parameter production bindings and sizing evidence are incomplete

risks.mitigation: Retain fork, testnet, and live evidence for token metadata refresh, animation execution, marketplace display, royalty display, event replay, and cache invalidation.
risks.residual_risk: Local browser and fixture checks do not prove collector-facing marketplace behavior.
risks.source: clean-main reviewer rebaseline and release readiness dashboard
risks.title: Marketplace, indexer, and metadata browser evidence is incomplete

risks.mitigation: Decide and implement or explicitly defer contract-level metadata, 1/1 provenance manifests, artist/authenticity records, royalty policy, collector permanence packages, and marketplace/indexer evidence.
risks.residual_risk: The protocol can be locally safe without yet meeting a world-class collector-facing 1/1 release bar.
risks.source: clean-main reviewer rebaseline and integration-readiness roadmap
risks.title: Best-in-class 1/1 product surfaces remain design and evidence work

risks.mitigation: Retain reviewed fork/testnet/live provider configuration, funding, request health, epoch, stale/failure/retry, and metadata-finalization evidence.
risks.residual_risk: Local mock provider evidence does not prove live provider funding, callback, or operational monitoring behavior.
risks.source: public-beta evidence blockers and randomizer operations runbook
risks.title: Non-local randomizer provider operations evidence is missing

risks.mitigation: Retain production checksum signatures, signed Git tag evidence, production deployment manifests, source verification inputs, and live bytecode/explorer proof.
risks.residual_risk: The local bytecode-to-release proof does not prove deployed live bytecode or production signer approval.
risks.source: production release blocker report and release-signature policy
risks.title: Production release signatures, signed tags, and live bytecode proof are missing

risks.mitigation: Recover real Core headroom through measured compression, extraction, or authorized relocation while retaining every mandatory hook; keep non-critical product surfaces satellite-first.
risks.residual_risk: The current 24,152-byte runtime leaves 424 bytes of EIP-170 headroom, 1,576 bytes below the non-waivable 2,000-byte production deployment minimum.
risks.source: launch conformance matrix, target architecture, and artifact-backed size proof
risks.title: StreamCore misses the normative production headroom gate

risks.mitigation: Disposition and remediate every open first-party production high/medium finding, retain issue-linked proof for each resolution, and keep the exact normalized baseline drift gate green.
risks.residual_risk: The current normalized baseline contains 3 High and 27 Medium open first-party production findings; local normalization and drift detection do not establish that any finding is safe.
risks.source: Normalized first-party production Slither high/medium baseline
risks.title: First-party production Slither findings remain open
